lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqí nǐ yào chūchāi ma?
lines.english: Are you going on a business trip next week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, going to Shanghai for a meeting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zuò fēijī qù háishi zuò gāotiě?
lines.english: Flying or taking the high-speed train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 坐高铁。只要四个小时，很方便。
lines.pinyin: Zuò gāotiě. Zhǐyào sì gè xiǎoshí, hěn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: Taking the high-speed train. Only four hours, very convenient.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Sān tiān. Kāi wán huì jiù huílai.
lines.english: Three days. Come back after the meeting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 订好了。离会议地点很近，走路五分钟。
lines.pinyin: Dìng hǎo le. Lí huìyì dìdiǎn hěn jìn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.english: Booked. Very close to the meeting place, five minutes walk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 祝你出差顺利，平安回来！
lines.pinyin: Zhù nǐ chūchāi shùnlì, píng'ān huílai!
lines.english: Wishing you a smooth business trip and safe return!
